<!-- Write the title and body in English. See the development guidance:
https://github.com/takahirox/msx-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md -->

## Problem

Describe the problem and why it matters.

## Expected outcome

Describe what should be true when the Issue is resolved.

## Context and reproduction

Add relevant context, examples, logs, or related Issues. Include reproduction steps and actual versus expected results when applicable.

## Pre-merge acceptance

List concrete, mandatory completion criteria that can be achieved and verified before merge.

- [ ] Describe a verifiable result.

Default to criteria an AI agent can execute and verify. Require human confirmation, physical-device testing, subjective evaluation, or external approval only when necessary for this Issue; explain why and what result is expected. Do not require checks possible only after merge as conditions for pre-merge approval.

## Optional validation

List useful additional checks separately from mandatory acceptance, or state "None."

## Required post-merge verification

Record genuinely necessary checks possible only after merge, or state "None." Do not add routine post-merge work without a need tied to this Issue. Report required checks as pending until performed; pre-merge validation does not prove deployment or publication succeeded.
